import json
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from part2.capital_flow import runner
from part2.capital_flow.contracts import FlowObservation

CLOCK = 1_800_000_000_000
FILES = ("latest.json", "audit_latest.json", "anata_latest.json")

def _economic_rows(sign):
    specs = (("etf", "net_flow_usd", "USD", 10000000),
             ("exchange_btc", "btc_netflow", "BTC", 100),
             ("stablecoin", "supply_change_usd", "USD", 100000000))
    rows = []
    for family, metric, unit, scale in specs:
        for i in range(8):
            stamp = CLOCK - (8 - i) * 3600000
            rows.append(FlowObservation(
                family=family, metric=metric, asset="BTC", value=sign * (i + 1) * scale,
                unit=unit, effective_at_ms=stamp, available_at_ms=stamp,
                observed_at_ms=stamp, source="same_offline_source",
                source_record_id=f"{family}-{i}", cadence_seconds=3600,
                provenance={"context_only": False}))
    return rows

def _snapshot(directory):
    return {name: json.loads((directory / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            for name in FILES}

def test_two_writers_same_clock_distinct_economic_generations(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    histories = {"writer-A": _economic_rows(1), "writer-B": _economic_rows(-1)}
    selected = {"name": "writer-A"}
    def offline_load(_path, *, max_records=None):
        name = threading.current_thread().name
        return list(histories[name if name in histories else selected["name"]])
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "load_observations", offline_load)

    oracles = {}
    for name in histories:
        selected["name"] = name
        root = tmp_path / name
        runner.run_once(local_dir=root, network=False, external_jsonl=(),
                        as_of_ms=CLOCK)
        oracles[name] = _snapshot(root)
    assert all(oracles["writer-A"][f] != oracles["writer-B"][f] for f in FILES), (
        "Fixture must distinguish economically opposite evidence in EACH output")
    shared = tmp_path / "shared"
    shared.mkdir()
    for f in FILES:
        (shared / f).write_text(json.dumps(oracles["writer-B"][f]), encoding="utf-8")

    a_latest, release_a, b_latest = (threading.Event() for _ in range(3))
    original_write = runner.atomic_write_json
    def gated_write(path, payload):
        original_write(path, payload)
        if Path(path).name == "latest.json":
            if threading.current_thread().name == "writer-A":
                a_latest.set()
                assert release_a.wait(20), "writer A release timeout"
            elif threading.current_thread().name == "writer-B":
                b_latest.set()
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "atomic_write_json", gated_write)
    errors = []
    def writer():
        try:
            runner.run_once(local_dir=shared, network=False,
                            external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=CLOCK)
        except BaseException as exc:
            errors.append(repr(exc))
    a = threading.Thread(target=writer, name="writer-A")
    b = threading.Thread(target=writer, name="writer-B")
    a.start()
    try:
        assert a_latest.wait(20), "A did not reach first output write"
        b.start()
        if b_latest.wait(5):
            b.join(20)  # Unlocked B overtakes paused A; serialized B waits.
            assert not b.is_alive(), "B did not complete after overtaking"
    finally:
        release_a.set()
        a.join(20)
        if b.ident is not None:
            b.join(20)
    assert not a.is_alive() and not b.is_alive(), "writer thread hung"
    assert not errors, errors
    assert not (shared / "observations.jsonl").exists()
    actual = _snapshot(shared)
    matches = {f: ("A" if actual[f] == oracles["writer-A"][f]
                   else "B" if actual[f] == oracles["writer-B"][f]
                   else "OTHER") for f in FILES}
    assert len(set(matches.values())) == 1 and "OTHER" not in matches.values(), matches
